results.title: Trump's approval stuck at 33%; Democrats appear more fired up for midterms, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds - Mon, 31 Aug 2026 PST
results.description: President Donald Trump's approval rating was stuck at the lowest level of his political career amid broad dissatisfaction over the war in Iran and the Republican's economic stewardship, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll ​that concluded on Monday.
